name: Blueprint 01 - AI Email Triage & Auto-Draft System (v1.2)

parameters.content:
## SETUP (5 min)
1. Gmail Trigger → connect your Gmail OAuth2 credential.
2. AI Classifier → create an **OpenAI API** credential (API key) and select it.
3. Slack node → connect Slack and change the channel `#sales-alerts` to yours (or delete the node).
4. Gmail Draft node → select the same Gmail credential.
5. Activate the workflow and send yourself a test email.

No credentials are included in this file.

## ROUTING
Output 0: **hot lead** = sales_lead + high urgency → Gmail draft + Slack alert
Output 1: billing_invoice → Gmail draft only
Output 2: everything else (support, normal leads) → Gmail draft only

Drafts are saved in the original thread. Nothing is sent automatically (human-in-the-loop).

## TIPS
- Edit the system prompt in node 2 to add your own categories, tone, or company details.
- Polling is every minute; raise it to save executions.
- Blueprint Systems AI · youtube.com/@BlueprintSystemsAI
- The email body is JSON-escaped automatically (JSON.stringify), so quotes and line breaks in emails won't break the request.
- The Gmail Trigger ignores your own drafts and sent replies (search filter `-from:me -in:drafts`), so drafts created by this workflow are never processed again.
